page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Additionally, there are no integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable resource for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without virtualization overhead. The hardware profile is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and databases that rely on network-attached storage.
